ops.loadingHours: Next to the banquet rooms there is a loading entrance that large trucks can drive into. Loading entrance dimensions: Tsuru 2.80 m wide x 2.90 m high; Fuyo 2.77 m wide x 2.30 m high (vehicles can pull up alongside and unload as they are); Hō 1.96 m wide x 2.10 m high; edo ROOM 1.80 m wide x 2.28 m high.
ops.parking: The car parks of The Main, Garden Tower and Garden Court together have 760 spaces. The fee is 500 yen per 30 minutes (tax included). Attendees of general banquets receive a parking service ticket depending on the time, giving up to 4 hours free (up to 6 hours for weddings). Time beyond that is charged at the regular parking rate.
ops.waitingRooms: The foyer of Tsuru (460㎡) and the foyer of Fuyo (625㎡) can be used as waiting rooms, etc. For PALAZZO OTANI, AZALEA and ACERO, the waiting rooms Tsubaki (65㎡), Tachibana (164㎡) and Sakura (89㎡) can be used. edo ROOM has its own waiting room and powder room. Boardroom, Crescent, and Summit East / West are small banquet rooms that can be used for meals, meetings and waiting rooms.
ops.catering: Food and drinks are provided by the hotel. Seated dinner courses are accepted from 8 guests, and standing or seated buffets from 20 guests. Banquet boxed lunch menus and takeaway menus are available.
ops.restaurants: There are 36 restaurants and bars in the hotel.
